notes.title: New Demo for Zombactory comes out TOMORROW!
notes.content:
New Free Demo for Zombactory comes out in tomorrow! Wishlist now!

Tired of the same game mechanics? Well try out Zombactory, where you build walls of boxes to defend yourself against the zombie hoards. Upgrade your factory and skills as you find survivors. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44621679/5a87c42da49745038a0a41dec8543646da4e7808.png[/img]

edit: There have been some unforeseen delays, but we are working hard to get the demo out as soon as possible.

notes.title: Free Demo for Zombactory comes out in 2 days!
notes.content:
Alex is the new guy at the box warehouse, ending the day with a company dance party, but that night something goes horribly wrong! You and Alex defend against the zombie hoard by building walls of boxes from factories, with help from your rag-tag group of survivors.

Fight your way through the levels as you save survivors and upgrade your factories and conveyor belts, choose your skill tree upgrade path, and explore the story of the corruption of Norwick as you save people from the zombies taking over.

Crisp controls, isometric graphics, off-beat humor with a good story, and one-of-a-kind gameplay makes this an indie title not to miss!

Zombactory is a work in progress, and the free demo will be released on Tuesday so be sure to wishlist! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44621679/4bbcc0121f6c7297b4a7613b17fad0e441b05638.png[/img]

notes.title: New Free Demo for Zombactory comes out in 4 days! Wishlist to be reminded!
notes.content:
New Free Demo for Zombactory comes out in 4 days! Wishlist to be reminded!

Dive into the post-apocalyptic world of "Zombactory" where survival is an art and every box counts. Experience the gripping struggle of humanity against relentless hordes of zombies in this unique isometric indie game that combines strategic base-building, resource management, and an engaging storyline.
